paragraphs.text: Skeleton is a creature type used for cards that depict the magically animated bones of deceased creatures. Many depict human skeletons, but as with other types depicting undead, Skeleton serves as both a species and a class , and the Human subtype is omitted.

Skeletons are generally mono- black aligned, and all multicolored Skeletons are partially black. Skeletons were historically tied to regeneration , or self- reanimation after regeneration was deprecated.

Many Skeletons have an ability embodying the trope that the undead can reassemble themselves. Older cards can regenerate , and after that keyword was retired, newer designs sometimes have self- reanimation . Both variations are less common following the realization, during the development of Core Set 2019 , that the trope is somewhat dated and may not align with the expectations of younger players.
As of 2026, there are only five non-black Skeleton cards. Two of them were printed in Adventures in the Forgotten Realms , which depicts a setting from Dungeons & Dragons , rather than Magic .
In the Sixth Edition errata , the creature type Dead was obsoleted in favor of Skeleton. This affected a single card, Kjeldoran Dead / Kjeldoran Dead .

For some older sets, artwork containing skeletons was changed or replaced for release in mainland China. Skeletons were perceived as an unlucky symbol by older generations, and Chinese regulations prohibit the promotion of superstition. By the development of Shards of Alara (released 2008), cultural norms had shifted, and artwork from that and later sets was released in China without modification.
Affected sets include Urza's Saga , Sixth Edition , Seventh Edition , Ravnica: City of Guilds , and Guildpact .
Skeletons are common on Grixis , where they are soldiers and servants for the shard's necromancers. Grixian skeletons typically lack the capacity to reassemble themselves.
Undead human knights, known as deathless riders, lich-knights, or fell horsemen, patrol the outer Wilds in service of the Shadow Queen of castle Dynnistad.
Skeletons called phylaskia guard the borders of The Underworld .
